title: Rosalind and the Winter
author: Coral Lockridge
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
